title: humanoid_parkour round input
description: Evaluation shape for one round. The course is static and the instance suite is a fixed, stratified friction sweep built inside the referee (env/sim.instance_spec) — the round input only carries the (miner-visible, non-secret) evaluation dimensions.

num_instances.description: Evaluation instances. Friction levels are spread evenly across the range, so this also sets how finely the grippy-to-slippery continuum is sampled.

max_steps_per_episode.description: Control-step cap per instance (1 step = 20 ms sim time, so 4000 = 80 s).

deadline_ms.description: Per-/act deadline for the policy, enforced by the referee's HTTP client.
